title: Bulk look up multiple Twitter/X tweets by their numeric tweet IDs in a single re
description: Bulk look up multiple Twitter/X tweets by their numeric tweet IDs in a single request. Each tweet includes full text, author profile, and engagement metrics. Query param: ids (string, required) - comma-separated numeric tweet IDs, max 50, e.g. GET /tweets?ids=1110302988,1234567890. Returns X v2 API-compatible JSON.

_signals.x_guidance: This API requires MPP payment via Tempo for each request. Costs range from $0.0025 to $0.01 USDC per call. To use: (1) send a probe request to get a 402 challenge, (2) pay via Tempo using an MPP client such as mppx, (3) retry with the payment credential in the Authorization header. No gas required — server sponsors all Tempo gas fees.
